summary: Verified two user-reported mobile bug fixes on Platinum Group site. BUG 1 (footer ENQUIRE not opening on mobile) and BUG 2 (cookie banner clipped/overlapping on mobile) are FIXED at the primary mobile viewports (390x844 and 360x640). Cookie banner sits fully in viewport, clears the mobile CTA bar with margin, and the footer ENQUIRE link is now click-through to /enquire where data-testid='lead-form' renders. Desktop (1920x800): banner appears bottom-left with proper geometry, accept works, footer ENQUIRE navigates to /enquire with lead form visible. Typo fix confirmed on /opulence Kitchen accordion — item #3 now reads 'Ceramic Tiles Dado upto 2 Feet Height'. Zero console errors on /, /opulence, /greens, /enquire. Minor edge-case: at 320x568 (iPhone SE / very small), the cookie banner wraps to 146px tall which combined with the 70px bottom offset (~216px total from bottom) exceeds the footer's pb-40 (160px) clearance, so the banner still intercepts the footer ENQUIRE tap on that specific viewport. Not part of the originally reported bug set (user reported on standard mobile) but worth a note.

ui_bugs.issue: At 320x568 the cookie banner (146px tall due to narrow-width text wrap) sits over the footer link row, intercepting pointer events on the footer ENQUIRE link. At 390x844 and 360x640 it works correctly.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Increase footer bottom padding on very small screens (<360px) or lower the cookie banner text size / two-column button row so total banner height stays under ~120px. Suggested fix: bump footer pb-40 -> pb-56 on sm:below or reduce cookie banner padding on <sm.
critical_code_review_comments: CookieConsent.jsx: banner uses z-[90] which is higher than mobile CTA bar z-[70] — correct. Bottom offset calc(70px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)) is 70px, but mobile CTA bar is ~50px tall — the extra 20px gap is fine.

Footer.jsx: pb-40 (160px) on mobile provides clearance for banner (typical 126px) + CTA bar (50px). Marginal at 320px viewports where banner wraps taller (146px). Consider pb-52/pb-56 on <sm breakpoint or dynamic padding based on banner presence.
CookieConsent entrance is opacity-only fade — no y-translation clipping risk. Good.
seed_data_creation: None. localStorage 'pg-cookie-consent' cleared before banner tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To reproduce the banner, run localStorage.removeItem('pg-cookie-consent') and reload; banner appears after ~1.8s. Mobile CTA bar is 49.5px tall (z-70). Banner z-90 with calc(70px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)) bottom offset. Footer pb-40 on mobile. All primary-mobile flows pass; only sub-360px viewport shows residual overlap.
rca of the issue: Original bug: cookie banner (fixed, positioned at bottom-6) overlapped the fixed mobile CTA bar and the footer link row, and its entrance animation used a translateY that could clip. Fix: banner repositioned to bottom-[calc(70px+env(safe-area-inset-bottom))] on mobile (above CTA bar), animation reduced to opacity-only, max-h-[60vh] with scroll, and footer given pb-40 on mobile so link row scrolls clear. Verified working at 390x844 and 360x640; residual overlap remains at 320x568 due to banner height growing when text wraps.
